title: Shapes of Carbon Compounds: sp³, sp², sp
subject: Chemistry
chapter: Organic Chemistry – Some Basic Principles and Techniques
objective: Methane, ethene and ethyne all contain carbon but have different shapes. Hybridisation, and a quick way to find it.

fill.q: sp² carbon has a bond angle of ____ degrees.
A carbon with 3 groups around it is ____ hybridised.

tf.q: More s character gives a shorter bond.
tf.explain: s orbitals lie closer to the nucleus.

tf.q: A double bond counts as 2 groups.

ar.a: The C–H bond in ethyne is shorter than in ethane.
ar.r: sp carbon has more s character.
Each carbon has 3 groups around it.

mcq.q: The bond angle in methane is about:
The shape around sp carbon is:
Which has the least s character?

num.q: How many groups surround each carbon in ethyne?
steps: One H and the triple bond

num.q: How many sp³ carbons are in propene, CH₃CH=CH₂?

short.q: State the shortcut to find hybridisation.
short.solution: Count the groups around carbon: 4 is sp³, 3 is sp², 2 is sp. A multiple bond counts as one group.
